verdict.rationale: Caching resolved actions or generated code for deterministic replay is a fair question for an AI browser-automation API, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions action caching, script generation, or replay. Structured outputs (smooth-docs-5) only make the agent's output deterministic to consume, and browser profiles (smooth-docs-17) only reuse login state; neither replays actions without re-prompting the LLM.
